pages.title: What it does
pages.text: Makes you translucent and causes mobs to stop detecting you in the usual way.$(br2)$(bold)$(#7952A6)Requirement:$() Path level 5.

pages.title: Use and limits
pages.text: Use Vanishing to pass dangerous creatures or buy time to escape. It costs hunger when switched on and has a cooldown. It has no time limit: switch it on and off yourself whenever you need.
